findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 2
Raise: Functional. Case: normal use - running the repository suite or starter smoke workflow. Moving the table screens into libraries leaves `tests/test_defaults_formats.py:90–92` searching only `apps/web/src`, so `test_4_each_table_exports_csv_from_one_shared_code_path` now unconditionally fails with “no list screen renders a table.” Its sibling formatting test also writes probes into the deleted `apps/web/src/features` directory at lines 25, 33 and 69, causing FileNotFoundError in live runs before lint executes. Update these remaining consumers to exercise the new library locations.

findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 2
Raise: Functional. Case: normal use - adding a cross-module relative import inside a module's pages or hooks folder. These [gitignore-style patterns](https://eslint.org/docs/latest/rules/no-restricted-imports#patterns) match only the fixed parent depth. For example, `libs/projects/web/src/pages/reach-in.ts` can import `../../../../organisations/web/src/index` without matching either restriction. This bypasses the promised cross-module web boundary in the folders where the moved screens actually live. The proof at `tests/test_libs_layout.py:300–302` exercises only imports directly under `src`, so it misses this failure. Cover normal nested source locations in both the restriction and its command-level test.
findings.title: Enforce Python web boundaries from nested screen and hook folders
